description.value: Icy Bar is a Taiwanese-style shaved-ice dessert bar specializing in DIY bowls, signature fruity shaved icy, and soft snowflake milk ice customized with toppings like mochi, grass jelly, fresh fruit, and red bean. The Richmond shop is one of several Lower Mainland locations and also offers catering and self-serve dessert stations for private events. It could serve as a cooling refreshment stop for touring cyclists passing through the Number 3 Road corridor.
